evidence_notes.continuity: The drift question now has a documented answer: graduate Computer Graphics (289H, Fall 2025) and Architecture (201A) coursework plus research units every quarter through Winter 2026. GPU work did not stop at the paper.
evidence_notes.trajectory: The spine reads without silence: HS → CC (under HS, then two at once) → BS → VIDI Lab research → MS (paper published inside it, lab work continuing) → MelioraOS in the final quarter → looking for work. Fully dated except VIDI’s exact edges.

Was once the weakest row; no longer.
